name: Interim HR Solutions
title: Interim HR Solutions in the Netherlands | HRhelp
metaDescription: Senior interim HR cover for your Dutch entity when a role falls vacant. One named consultant, fixed monthly fee, typically starting within five working days.
tagline: Senior cover for a defined gap
hero: Interim HR solutions give you a senior HR professional who runs your Dutch HR function while a gap is open. You get continuity from the day someone leaves until your permanent hire is fully up to speed.
premiseHeading: Your HR manager has gone, and the Dutch entity still has contracts, cases and deadlines running.
premiseBody: The trigger is usually simple. Someone resigns, goes on parental or long term sick leave, or the Dutch operation grows faster than the person holding HR together can absorb. Meanwhile contracts expire, sickness files need updating and managers keep asking questions nobody is answering.

HRhelp places one named senior consultant into that seat for a period you can name. They take over the live work, keep the function running to Dutch standards, and hand a documented department to whoever comes next.

included.title: Contracts and lifecycle
included.desc: Offers, contracts, extensions, probation decisions and exits handled end to end for your Dutch staff.

included.title: Live case handover
included.desc: Open sickness, performance and exit cases are picked up on day one rather than left to drift.

included.title: Absence management
included.desc: The full statutory reintegration timetable is tracked, with the occupational health service and UWV managed for you.

included.title: Payroll interface
included.desc: Monthly mutations prepared and checked with your existing payroll provider before each run.

included.title: Manager support
included.desc: Your line managers get one named person to call before a conversation with an employee goes wrong.

included.title: Structured handover
included.desc: Files, policies and open cases are documented and transferred in the closing weeks of the mandate.

benefits.title: Cover in days, not months
benefits.desc: A senior consultant is normally productive within a week. You are not waiting out a three month notice period with the function unattended.

benefits.title: A cost you can budget
benefits.desc: One fixed monthly fee agreed before the start. A contested exit or a difficult sickness case does not change the invoice.

benefits.title: Deadlines stop being your problem
benefits.desc: Notice dates, chain rule limits and reintegration checkpoints keep running while a role is empty. Your consultant owns them from day one.

benefits.title: Senior only, never a trainee
benefits.desc: Every HRhelp consultant has 15+ years in Dutch employment practice and is a native Dutch speaker working fluently in English.

examples.situation: The HR manager of a US owned software company in Amsterdam resigned with two open dismissal files and eleven fixed term contracts due to expire that quarter. HQ was four time zones away and had no view of the Dutch obligations.
examples.result: A consultant started within a week, issued every outstanding notice on time, closed both exits by settlement agreement, and handed a clean file set to the permanent hire four months later.

examples.situation: A long serving HR lead went on sick leave with no defined return date, days before the annual pay review and a collective agreement indexation deadline.
examples.result: HRhelp ran the review cycle and the indexation on schedule, kept the works council relationship intact, and stepped back gradually when the HR lead returned part time.

examples.situation: A German group discovered that its Dutch branch had been running HR out of the finance team for two years. Nobody had tracked contract chains or reintegration duties.
examples.result: A six month interim mandate cleared the backlog, corrected two contracts that had already converted to permanent by law, and left the branch with a written HR calendar.

process.title: Gap assessment
process.desc: We map what the departing person actually owned, plus every open case and deadline already running.

process.title: Consultant match and fee
process.desc: One named senior consultant is matched on sector and case type, with the fixed monthly fee agreed in writing.

process.title: Embedded delivery
process.desc: The consultant runs the function from inside your organisation, reporting to your managing director and group HR lead.

process.title: Handover
process.desc: Documented files, policies and live cases are transferred to your permanent hire before the mandate closes.

ideal: Your Dutch HR manager has resigned or is on extended leave
You need near full time cover for a period with a foreseeable end
Headquarters sits abroad and has no Dutch employment expertise in house
You want the gap covered without adding permanent headcount

faqs.q: How quickly can an interim HR consultant start?
faqs.a: Typically within five working days for a standard mandate. If something urgent is running, such as an unmanaged sickness case or a pending exit, we cover that immediately while the full engagement is scoped.

faqs.q: How is interim HR priced?
faqs.a: A fixed monthly fee based on scope and headcount, agreed before the start. There is no hourly meter, so case complexity never changes what you pay.

faqs.q: How does this differ from fractional HR?
faqs.a: Interim cover is near full time and ends when the gap closes, usually when a permanent hire starts. Fractional HR is an ongoing part time arrangement with no planned end date, for companies that will not need a full time HR head for years.

faqs.q: Are you an employer of record?
faqs.a: No. HRhelp does not employ your staff and is not an EOR or PEO. Your people stay on your Dutch entity's payroll while our consultant runs the HR function for you.

metaDescription: Ongoing part time senior HR for your Dutch entity, one or two fixed days a week. One named consultant, fixed monthly fee, no full time HR head on your payroll.

hero: Fractional HR gives you a senior HR professional in a permanent seat, filled on a part time basis. You get the judgement of an HR director on one or two fixed days a week, without carrying one on the payroll.
premiseHeading: You have outgrown HR as a side task, but a full time HR hire would sit idle half the year.
premiseBody: A few hires, one or two exits and a sickness case per quarter will never fill a full time role, yet every one of those items carries real cost if it is handled badly. Meanwhile a junior generalist can process paperwork but cannot advise your country manager on a contested exit.
Fractional HR is the standing answer. One named senior consultant works fixed, recurring days in your business and stays in that seat for years, with the days in between covered by phone and email.

benefits.desc: The expensive decisions in Dutch HR are legal ones. You get a consultant with 15+ years of Dutch employment practice making them.

examples.situation: A UK owned company in Utrecht had grown from 12 to 40 people in two years with a global handbook that conflicted with Dutch minimums on holiday and notice.
examples.result: Two days a week for the first quarter, then one day a week ongoing. The policy set was localised, and the arrangement has run for three years across two country managers.

examples.situation: A sector collective agreement turned out to apply to the Dutch entity by activity, even though the company had never signed one. Pay scales and allowances were out of line.
examples.result: The consultant mapped every role to the correct scale, corrected pay over the affected period before it became a claim, and now runs the January and July indexation as routine.

examples.situation: Founders were handling HR between them, and the first long term sickness case exposed how little of the statutory process anyone understood.

faqs.q: How is fractional HR different from interim HR?
faqs.a: Interim HR fills a defined gap at close to full time and ends when the gap closes. Fractional HR is ongoing part time support with no planned end date, sized for companies that will not need a full time HR head for several years.

faqs.q: What does fractional HR cost?
faqs.a: A fixed monthly fee tied to the agreed scope and number of days, not an hourly rate. You approve the figure before the engagement begins and it does not move because a case runs longer than expected.

faqs.q: Can one or two days a week really cover a long term sickness case?
faqs.a: Yes, provided milestones are tracked continuously rather than only on office days. The statutory checkpoints are calendar driven and your consultant is reachable in between.

faqs.q: What happens when we outgrow the model?
faqs.a: That is the intended path. Your consultant writes the job profile, supports the recruitment and hands over a documented function to your first in house HR hire.
